promotion_trigger: Promote when every entry validates the schema and the instant-play and no-rights gating hold through the catalog surface.
active_gate_evidence: The packaging and legal surface keep identity and rights records that the schema can bind to.
procedure: Validate every declared entry against the frozen schema.
Assert instant-play only for approved redistribution with passing capability.
